title: React Router app renders and deep links resolve
intent: Tests client-side routing plus the dev server's history fallback, which together are what every single-page app depends on.
source: stackblitz-conformance: React Router (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)
knownLimits: A deep link that 404s is a routing-layer finding; the SPA fallback is served by the dev server, not by our runtime.
